Thanks again for the demo last week. To get Nebula live on the AWS Marketplace and wire up procurement/POs cleanly, we need a couple of intake items from your side. I attached a short Marketplace_Intake_Form.xlsx that covers the key fields; can you confirm the following when you have a moment?

- Legal billing entity name and tax ID (W9/EIN for US sellers; VAT/equivalent for EU).

We typically ask for a signed MSA via DocuSign (link below) and the PO routing/template if you invoice us directly. If you prefer to use AWS marketplace billing, we can skip direct invoicing but will still need the legal entity and tax details for our procurement records.

Hey Maya —

Thanks for the quick reply. Answers inline below and a couple of things attached: PO_Routing_Template.docx and a filled example of the intake form.

1) W9: For US entities, we need a completed W9 on file for tax purposes. The EIN alone is not sufficient for our AP system — please include a signed W9 (scanned PDF) if you are a US vendor.

2) MSA + Marketplace billing: Yes — we can have the MSA signed via DocuSign while using AWS marketplace billing. If you route charges through the marketplace, Redwood will pay AWS invoices and AWS will remit to Nebula (per AWS process). We still need the legal entity + tax info for our records and to map invoices to the correct GL.

3) PO template: attached (PO_Routing_Template.docx) — it shows PO number format (RED-YYYY-#####) and remit-to sections. If you plan to invoice us directly (instead of marketplace), please use that remit format and send invoices to invoices@redwoodinference.com with the PO number on the header.

Notes by channel (short):
- AWS Marketplace: provide ListingOwner contact, Marketplace Seller ID, and billing preference (AWS to invoice Redwood).
- GCP Marketplace: similar but requires Cloud Billing Account linkage; share Cloud Billing Account ID.
- Azure Marketplace: we need the Publisher ID and validated offer.

DocuSign MSA: https://www.docusign.com/en/contract/REDWOOD-MSA-NEB-2027

Attaching: Marketplace_Intake_Form_filled_example.xlsx, PO_Routing_Template.docx

Thanks — once we have the W9 and confirmation of marketplace billing, Laura/Vanessa will finalize PO or marketplace billing mapping.

Best,
Ben

Hi all —

Looping in a few procurement/finance details you can expect on our side:

- Invoicing: If you bill via AWS Marketplace, we consume AWS invoices (we do not require a separate Nebula invoice). If you bill directly, invoices must be emailed to invoices@redwoodinference.com and include the PO number (RED-YYYY-#####) and remit information exactly as in the template.
- Tax: W9 required for US entities. For foreign entities, we require appropriate tax forms (W-8BEN-E or local equivalent) and certificate of VAT registration where applicable.
- Payment terms: Standard is NET30. If you need different terms, please note on the intake form and we will route to finance for approval.
- Bank verification: For new vendors billing directly, AP will complete ACH validation before first payment — expect a 5–7 business day verification window.

Maya — if you confirm AWS Marketplace billing, Laura will create the internal mapping ticket to route AWS invoices to the correct cost center and we can skip the bank verification step. If you invoice us directly, please attach the W9 and remit info so AP can start the ACH process.

Thanks,
